import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXNODES = 10000010;
    static final int INF_VAL = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int total_nodes, total_edges, c_param, d_param, k_param, total_flow_cost = 0;
    static int source = 0, sink, edge_idx = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[MAXNODES], to = new int[MAXNODES], next_edge = new int[MAXNODES], capacity = new int[MAXNODES], weight = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXNODES], flow_limit = new int[MAXNODES], parent_edge = new int[MAXNODES];
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAXNODES];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int w) {
        to[++edge_idx] = v; next_edge[edge_idx] = head[u]; head[u] = edge_idx; capacity[edge_idx] = cap; weight[edge_idx] = w;
        to[++edge_idx] = u; next_edge[edge_idx] = head[v]; head[v] = edge_idx; capacity[edge_idx] = 0; weight[edge_idx] = -w;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(flow_limit, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF_VAL);
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        flow_limit[source] = INF_VAL;
        in_queue[source] = true;
        dist[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll(); in_queue[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = next_edge[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] == 0 || dist[to[i]] <= dist[u] + weight[i]) continue;
                dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + weight[i];
                flow_limit[to[i]] = Math.min(flow_limit[u], capacity[i]);
                parent_edge[to[i]] = i;
                if (!in_queue[to[i]]) {
                    in_queue[to[i]] = true;
                    q.offer(to[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != INF_VAL;
    }

    static void augment_flow() {
        int node = sink;
        while (node != source) {
            int i = parent_edge[node];
            capacity[i] -= flow_limit[sink];
            capacity[i ^ 1] += flow_limit[sink];
            node = to[i ^ 1];
        }
        total_flow_cost += flow_limit[sink] * dist[sink];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total_nodes = sc.nextInt();
        total_edges = sc.nextInt();
        k_param = sc.nextInt();
        c_param = sc.nextInt();
        d_param = sc.nextInt();

        sink = (total_nodes + k_param - 1) * total_nodes + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k_param; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(source, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= total_edges; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= total_nodes + k_param; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= k_param; h++) {
                    int cap = 1;
                    int w = d_param * h * 2 - d_param + c_param;
                    add_edge(x + (j - 1) * total_nodes, y + j * total_nodes, cap, w);
                    add_edge(y + (j - 1) * total_nodes, x + j * total_nodes, cap, w);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < total_nodes + k_param; i++) {
            for (int j = 2; j <= total_nodes; j++) {
                add_edge(j + (i - 1) * total_nodes, j + i * total_nodes, INF_VAL, c_param);
            }
            add_edge(1 + (i - 1) * total_nodes, 1 + i * total_nodes, INF_VAL, 0);
        }

        while (spfa()) {
            augment_flow();
        }

        System.out.println(total_flow_cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
